r.t: Lunge is a pretty solid detective with good deductions, abduction, induction, Logical & Abstract Thinking, Decent Strategies & Planning.

Lunge is investigating the murder of a prostitute who was connected to an MP (Member of Parliament), he analyses the crime and deduces that the victim is no ordinary prostitute & that she was connected to multiple figures in Germany’s political & financial worlds. He manages to find a list of the prostitutes clients but it was coded so you couldn’t tell the clients real names.

He then goes on his computer and decodes the password of the prostitutes client list so he then convert it into real names. When getting to the house of the suspect, one of men connected to the suspect says the MP had an alibi but since Lunge deciphered client list he managed to make a connection that make a connection with the victim & the MP called Joseph Boltzmann due to his name being in her client list after it was decoded, he deduced that the MP likely hired a professional to kill the prostitute.

Lunge later on abduces a potential motive by asking the man who was the Press Secretary & Representative of Boltzmann if he’s familiar with the “Schellhorn publishing company” he then goes onto say they publish books exposing scandals of famous people, using unorthodox methods of exposing people saying they hire indecent women to make relationships with famous people & make those women write down the details of the interactions, implying the MP likely had her killed since engaging with prostitutes is likely deemed highly unprofessional and looked down upon for someone high up in the political chain.

Later on Lunge returns to the house of the Secretary to question him & ask him if he had any contact with a man called Junker as he was a professional assassin, Lunge had likely figured out that the Secretary hired the assassin to kill her to orchestrate the cover up scandal to help Boltzmann. The secretary becomes visibly shaken & angry by Lunges deductions and tells him to leave.

Lunge shows good Emotional Management & Control when he gets home & his wife revealed she was having an affair + her daughter was pregnant, he doesn’t get enraged or saddened. Simply he calmly leaves after a phone call to return to a crime scene at the secretaries place which reveals he had killed himself likely out of guilt or fear from being exposed orchestrating the murder of the prostitute.
ALL FEATS shown in this episode.

>=Great Deductive, Abductive & Inductive reasoning, great analysis & observation, great emotional management, Good decoding skills, VCI, PSI & PRI. Great at connecting the dots, Indirect Suicide Insinuation, Composure

Introduction: At the beginning of the episode we see crowds of people and reporters asking one of the police working in the BKA about the murder victims (The Jopps couple) asking if they’re killings are related to the Middle Aged Couple murders and are the same killers.

It then cuts to Lunge speaking to one of the journalists who asks the same question to Lunge and Lunge falsely says yes deceiving & misdirecting the journalist knowing full well that it’s not the truth. This also means he was fully aware of the people there currently, their thoughts and the situation. This will come back in full circle with his next conversation with the Journalist.

Lunge then is shown going to the house of the victims and putting his mind into the killer of the couple, psychologically analysing them & the crime while creating an accurate profile of the killer. When Lunge walks into the house he says something (in the Japanese Dub) along the lines of “What a courteous old couple, I’ve been invited to the living room without hesitation, they don’t suspect a thing” this quote will be very important later on in the analysis of the episode when he finds out who the killer is.

He perfectly is able to visualise exactly what the victims where doing in the house after the murderer is inside, such as knowing & stating that the wife was in the kitchen making tea & was killed before tea was prepared. Then is he able to emotionally perceive & understand what the victim just before her (the husband) was feeling (confusion) before then being stabbed by the perpetrator then running holding his wounds, he even visualises the exact striking patterns with the knife of the assailant in the exact order.

Lunge also abduced while recreating the murder that the attacker is very inexperienced with Crime as he misses a lot of his swings. Johan who responsible for the middle aged couple Murders was very experienced in criminal methodology & execution since he was as child so he already suspects the killers of the 4 middle aged couples & the Jopps couple killings have different perpetrators.

Lunge once again uses his Psychological & Emotional Intelligence to perceive the fact that the husband (as one logically would in a situation like this) cried out for the wife’s help but knows she can’t hear him in the Kitchen due to the set-up of the house and the Tea brewing likely making noise. Before visualising the killing blow he sees the husbands left hand print of blood on the table (from holding his wounds) while being walked down by the killer, he realised that the killer didn’t deliver the final blow while he was at the table as he then sees the victims chalk outlining of the body 5 metres away from there.
>=Abduction,Abductive Reasoning, connecting the dots, Psychological Analysis & profiling, Emotional Perception & Understanding, Great VSI, Elite observation, good precision

He then shortly speaks to a woman about the Jopps couple, Lunge gives her a photograph of Dr Tenma saying that if he comes over to the neighbourhood of the Jopps couple for her to treat him very welcomingly & to call Lunge essentially setting a trap for Dr Tenma as due to the evidence Johan plants on him Lunge still suspects he’s the killer of the Middle Aged Couples but Lunge says to the woman he knows that Tenma didn’t kill the Jopps couple (as the murdering styles are different).

When the woman says that she used to call out to the Mrs Jopps & she’d respond cheerfully, Lunge says that Mrs Jopps wouldn’t have been able to hear her since he finds out that she’s hard of hearing through her doctors reports. He then asks her if anyone else in the neighbourhood had heard of her hard hearing & she says no, Lunge in his mind knows that none of the people in the neighbourhood had killed her as they wouldn’t have been able to take advantage of Mrs Jopps hearing problems.

Later on Lunge goes to speak to a man named Mr.Giebel who owns his own very successful company in Car Dealership, he also recently lost his Aunt & Uncle (The Jopps) in a murder. Lunge then asks how much Giebel inherited from his Aunt/Uncles death, Giebel asks what it has to do with the case & Lunge responds saying he’d be the only one to inherit anything from their deaths and have the most to gain from it. Giebel then gets angry & defensive asking Lunge if he’s being accused of the crime for inheritance money but what Lunge then does here is genius, he gives Giebel (the man who he suspects) a false sense of security and comfort saying “he took his secretary & subordinates out to eat with witnesses being able to testify to that”. Confused by this Giebel asks Lunge again what he means and Lunge says to him again “You’re not the killer, that’s right isn’t it” almost Gaslighting & guilt tripping him.
>=Cold Reading, Information Gathering, Composure, Gaslighting, Guilt tripping & Emotional Manipulation

The journalist then meets Lunge again and then exclaims that when he looked into the Nephew of the Jopps couple Giebel the company looked good but being it all their stockbrokers mess up & their financial state is a shambles knowing Lunge has been investigating them, he asks Lunge what the truth behind the case is if he sees the Jopps murder as part of the previous Middle Aged Couples or not exclaiming if there’s not connection of motive between them then it would be a terrible error of miscommunication getting him in trouble. Lunge then says it’s like he suspects it’s a copycat killer trying to take advantage  & blend the murder in with the other couple killings.

When the journalist states he much change stories Lunge tells him not to do so and to keep it as it is saying that all the couple killings including the Jopps killing are one in the same, he does this because he knows that Tenma will investigate the couple killings at the scene since Tenma would think that the killer is Johan which would goading & baiting Tenma into Lunge’s Trap. (Remember Lunge knows Tenma didn’t kill the Jopps couple but due to Johans excellent criminology & framing he still believes Tenma killed the other Middle Aged couples hence why he wants to chase & catch Tenma). The journalist initially refuses but then Lunge pressures him by blackmailing him on the spot telling the journalist that he knew that he was cheating on his partner having an affair with another woman.
>=Strategical Deception,Deception,Direct Control & Manipulation, Coercion, Setting Traps, Use of Misinformation, Information Gathering & Control, Hot Reading

After Tenma has arrived and has entered the house of one of the neighbours of the Jopps couple to find out about the murders, (as Tenma assumes it was Johan thanks to Lunge manipulating the journalist into putting out false information on the case baiting Tenma into coming to the crime scene for Lunge to catch him) the woman calls Lunge to let him know that Tenma has arrived. Right after this Lunge gets a visit from Giebel telling Lunge that he didn’t commit any of the crimes despite having motive and Lunge suspecting him. Lunge not showing much care simply says the Police called off the people following Giebel treating him as innocent & stated he had a place to be. Lunge also states in front of the suspect Giebel that he couldn’t care less about the killer as long as he catches a certain man (Tenma). Giebel asks who Lunge thinks the murderer of the Jopps couple is, Lunge blatantly tells him that it’s copycat of the previous killers due to the killings once he analysing them showing signs of emotion due to the hesitation which was missing in contrast to Johans killings which had no emotional attachment or hesitation at all, this puts Giebel under pressure as Lunge has gotten into his head.
>=Seeing though people, Connecting the Dots, Criminal & Psychological Analysis, Abduction,Abductive Reasoning,Psychological Control, Verbal Deception

Once Tenma comes to the same conclusion as Lunge did, Lunge comes to the crime scene where he knows for a fact Tenma will be waiting there as he knows exactly how Tenma’s mind works. He chases Tenma with a gun trying to shoot him while Tenma escapes but here’s the twist, the real murderer of the Jopps couple is in fact Giebel himself as he stabs Lunge in the foot after also coming to the crime scene where he killed his Aunt & Uncle and confesses to the crime basically baiting the real criminal to reveal himself after Lunge had gaslit, guilt tripped & psychologically out fear into him thinking he would need to kill Lunge to tie up what could be a loose end.
